context: A Wednesday night. Kenji and Yuki are the last two in the office, finishing a deadline project together.
purpose: colleague late-night solidarity — work intimacy and small soft moments at midnight

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: もう、十時過ぎちゃった。
lines.style: Office woman tired clock-check, the late-night fatigue audible, soft real weariness threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はやいね、あと少しだから。

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: コーヒーいる？私、淹れる。

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Salaryman warm relieved acceptance, the casual gratitude audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今回の資料、なんでこんなに細かいの。

lines.style: Office woman wry tired complaint, the shared frustration carried with warmth, soft real exhaustion threading throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長のこだわりってやつ。仕方ない。

lines.style: Salaryman dry knowing acceptance, the gentle worldly wisdom carried, soft real solidarity threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: でも、佐藤さんと一緒だから助かる。
lines.en: But with you here, it's easier.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。一人だったら、心折れてる。
lines.en: Same here. Alone, I'd be broken.
lines.style: Salaryman honest matching warmth, the soft real vulnerability audible, gentle solidarity threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、コーヒー。砂糖たくさん入れた。
lines.en: Here, coffee. I put in lots of sugar.
lines.style: Office woman warm small care delivered, the attentive personalization audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Salaryman warm sincere appreciation, the small simple gratitude carrying weight, soft real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 終わったら、何か食べに行きたい。
lines.en: When we're done, I want to grab something to eat.
lines.style: Office woman warm forward-looking, the casual extension into shared after-work, soft real friendship throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいね。深夜のラーメン、美味しいやつ知ってる。
lines.en: Nice. I know a good late-night ramen place.
lines.style: Salaryman warm pleased offering, the casual after-work warmth audible, soft real connection threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: やったー、それ目標にする。
lines.en: Yay, I'll make that my goal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: よし、もうひと頑張りしよう。

lines.speaker: yuki_office
